The first-party form accepts a SoundCloud, Spotify, YouTube or direct-download track link and asks for artist name, email, track title, genre and background information. Standard submission is explicitly free. info@SoundChatRadio.com and irishandchin@gmail.com are first-party published general contacts but were excluded as replacements for the official form. Activity is supported by a live 24/7 schedule and an official story dated March 16, 2026. First-party audience figures are stored only as unverified platform claims. No form field, track link, email or submission was sent.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-18 from JAM Audio Live's official artist-submission, home, about and artist-service pages. The landing page accepts independent artists from every genre and supports Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, YouTube, Bandcamp, Dropbox, Google Drive or direct music links. It asks artists to include a short bio, origin and song story, mark explicit lyrics and ensure they have permission to submit. Every submission is described as human reviewed for possible live rotation, spotlights, charts, interviews and future broadcasts. The official call-to-action leads to a Google Form, but the form could not be passively loaded, so its fields, login, CAPTCHA, upload, consent and retention controls remain unknown. Optional paid services such as premium spotlights and audio services were recorded only as an adjacent pricing boundary. A protected contact address was not decoded. Activity is confirmed by a live 24/7 stream and June 2026 artist spotlights for artists from Croatia, Brazil and Glasgow. No form field, link, account, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-18 from Discover YOU RADIO's official artist-submission, artist-portal, real-radio, privacy and terms pages. The official page says initial rotation evaluation is free, only the official application is reviewed and general-contact or social-DM submissions can be disqualified. The visible form asks for artist/contact data, song title, iTunes or alternate link, biography, song inspiration, lyrics or instrumental status, one or two genres, optional ISRC, PRO, social and website links, purchase link, fit statement, Suno Pro/record-label interest and an explicit yes/no paid-promotional-opportunities choice. Tracks must be radio-ready and non-explicit. If selected, the station says it purchases the song on iTunes and adds it to rotation and its request catalog. submit@discoveryouradio.com and admin@discoveryouradio.com are first-party published in the privacy policy, but the official application remains canonical. The active Human Ear Queue, current request lineup, 2026 privacy policy and current 2026 briefing support activity. No form field, email, opt-in, purchase or submission was used.
